ai.summary: A hard-edged surface that groups related content, with optional header, body, and footer.
whenToUse: A group of related facts, settings, or actions needs a boundary of its own
Content sits inside another surface and needs a raised panel to read against it
A record needs a title, a body, and a row of actions below a rule
whenNotToUse: The whole card is one action — use a Button or a Link with card styling
You are nesting it inside another card to group further — two competing fills and shadows read as noise
The separation is a list of peers — use a plain list or a Separator
ai.accessibility: A card is a surface, not a control: it exposes no role, is not focusable, and has no interaction props, because a clickable card is a link or a button wearing a card's styling and adding a click handler here would produce something neither keyboard-reachable nor announced. `heading` renders as a `<span>`, not a heading, because the card does not know its level in the document outline — pass a real `<h2 slot="header">` when you need one. Slots are optional and each renders nothing when empty, so a card without a header carries no empty bordered band.
knownLimitations: There is no `size` prop: a card has no intrinsic height to scale, so `padding` is the axis it varies on
There is no click handler, by design — a card that navigates should be a Link, and one that acts should be a Button
